RECORDED, NO VERDICT (judgment=true; 3.0.0_SA_CVO grades this at L9). The full text is in the session log's 'S25-AC2' section; the four answers in brief:
(1) THE FIELD'S SHAPE AND WHY A READER CAN TRUST IT -- eight keys on ONE axis (how the run was configured, never what it decided): `forced` an explicit boolean on both branches and the discriminator; `mechanism` a string ('--fixture-remove' | 'none') so a second mechanism can be added without changing the discriminator's meaning; `fixture_remove_spec` the operator's RAW string beside `fixture_remove` the PARSED form, so a reader can check the parse rather than trust it; `removed_slice_count` derivable but printed; `run_id` WITH `run_id_source`, so the identifier carries its provenance claim and a consumer can reject on it; `disclosure_version` so a v1 record is distinguishable from a later one. Against TAXONOMY LAW: MECE over the declared domain (a run either was or was not forced; the code has no third state), same grain, one intent, and the remedy that moves `forced` true->false moves nothing else. THE REASON TO TRUST IT IS THE DEFAULT, not the shape: coverage_gate emits it with all-defaulted arguments, so a caller cannot omit it by forgetting -- suite test (j) is exactly that guarantee.
(2) CONSUMERS, CENSUSED WITH A DENOMINATOR RATHER THAN RECALLED -- comp-find 'coverage_verdict': 71 hits across 29,502 files (SURFACED 7, CONFIG 7, TEST 5, DOC 52). Stripping docs, scratch copies and the tool's own logs leaves THREE code readers plus the writer: (a) etfs-reports-orchestrator lambda_function.py:130 `_read_coverage_artifacts` does json.loads into a dict, and its ONLY downstream use of the verdict document is :428 `message += f"\n\nCoverage verdict: {json.dumps(artifacts['verdict'])}"` -- no schema validation, no key iteration, no allow-list, so an added key cannot break it and in fact PROPAGATES INTO THE OPERATOR ALERT, which is the reader who most needs to know a run was forced; (b) test_terminal_send.py:87, a stub matching on key NAME only; (c) test_egs15_september_refusal.py:174, which reads named fields and is blind to additive keys. NOTHING in the estate validates this object against a closed schema. STATED LIMIT: the census is REPO-SCOPED -- a human reading the JSON, or a future portal panel, is not covered by it and the census cannot see one.
(3) IS THE RUN ID JOINABLE TO A RUN LOG -- PARTLY, and here is exactly what it is. It is NOT the SSM CommandId: the orchestrator holds that id (send_command(...)['Command']['CommandId']) and does NOT pass it to the renderer -- the box's command line is `python3 render_month_end.py --month {month} --pdf --gate --s3-out {out}`, no id in argv and none in the environment -- and threading it in would mean editing the orchestrator, which this cell is forbidden to touch (EG-s-24's surface, live on ~4). What the field carries is a uuid4 minted by the run and PRINTED to stdout as 'RUN-ID: <id>'. That IS joinable, because SSM captures stdout as the invocation's StandardOutputContent and the orchestrator already reads get_command_invocation: the join runs artifact -> stdout -> SSM invocation, NOT artifact -> CommandId directly. `run_id_source` states which of the two it is on every record. A hook is left for the stronger case: ETFS_RUN_ID in the environment WINS if a caller supplies one, so EG-s-21 or a later orchestrator change can hand in an already-joinable id WITHOUT another renderer deploy.
(4) WHAT THIS DISCLOSURE DOES NOT PROVE -- (i) it does not make an unforced run TRUSTWORTHY: it records what the RENDERER was told, so a run distorted upstream (a producer that never wrote a slice, a truncated listing) reads forced:false truthfully and discloses nothing about that; (ii) it covers ONE forcing mechanism -- `--no-ladder` also changes what the run does (zero producer invokes, so no recovery can occur before the verdict) and is NOT recorded by this field, which is a real gap named here rather than left to imply completeness; (iii) it has NOT run on the box -- the bytes are deployed and byte-verified and the record was exercised hermetically through the real main(), but no box run has produced one of these documents under platinum/reports/, because that is EG-s-21's single permitted act and it is deliberately unspent; (iv) it cannot reach a reader who does not open the artifact -- the HTML, the PDF and the CSVs carry no forcing marker; (v) the run_id is NOT authenticated -- anything that can write the object can write any id.
